name: io.github.getapeptalk/speaker-finder
title: PepTalk Speaker Finder
description: Research keynote and event speakers in PepTalk's public catalogue and compare their public profiles.

tools.name: search-experts
tools.description: Search PepTalk's public speaker catalogue by topic, speaker name, session format, country, and optional budget. Returns public profile links and indicative fee bands when known. It does not confirm availability or make enquiries or bookings. For more options or other names, repeat the same search and pass every speaker already shown in excludeSpeakers; hasMore says whether further matches remain.

query.description: Topic, theme, speaker type, or speaker name to search for. Budget is set with budgetAmount, not in the query text.

topics.description: Exact topic names to filter by (e.g. "Effective Leadership", "Change Management"). Only use values you have seen returned in previous search results — do NOT infer topic names. Omit if unsure; the query handles relevance.

sessionFormat.description: Session format: online, in-person, or any

locations.description: Specific countries to restrict results to, as full canonical names ("United Kingdom", "United States", "Germany") — NOT abbreviations, regions, or cities. Expand any region, continent, or nationality the user mentions into its countries YOURSELF and list them here: "European speakers" → ["United Kingdom","Ireland","Germany","France","Spain","Italy","Netherlands",…]; "British" → ["United Kingdom"]; "based in London" → ["United Kingdom"]. For an exclusion ("the Americas but not the US"), list the region's countries and simply omit the excluded one. Omit entirely when the user names no place.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1 to 50, default 3).

budgetAmount.description: Numeric budget in the currency given by budgetCurrency (defaults to GBP). Extraction examples: "10k" → 10000, "around £15,000" → 15000, "20 grand" → 20000, "about 50k USD" → 50000 (and set budgetCurrency to "USD"), "small budget" → omit. Returns speakers whose fee is at or below this amount. Omit the field entirely if no budget mentioned — do not guess. When the user asks for cheaper or lower-fee alternatives without giving a specific number, look at the lowest fee shown in the previous results and set budgetAmount to a value below that — the goal is to surface a different, lower price tier.

budgetCurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency for budgetAmount (e.g. GBP, USD, EUR). Defaults to GBP if budgetAmount is set without a currency.

excludeSpeakers.description: Speakers already shown in this conversation, as the public profile URLs (or slugs) returned by earlier searches. Pass all of them when the user asks for more options or other names; they are skipped and the next-ranked matches are returned. Omit on a new search.

tools.name: get-speaker-details
tools.description: Get a speaker's public PepTalk profile, including biography, topics, indicative fee band, and optional testimonials. Use the public profile URL or slug returned by search-experts.

profile.description: The public getapeptalk.com speaker profile URL or its final path slug, as returned by search-experts.
